text:
mira: FYI rolling keystore IAM boundary change in apac just caused a provisioning disruption for a subset of GPU nodes. seeing a bunch of DecryptDenied errors and nodes stuck in Pending. cost alarm triggered for natgw egress at the same time :grimacing:
jon: oh no. which AZ/region? logs?
oliver: APAC = ap-southeast-1 we think — warm pool nodes hit first. can you paste the error?
mira: paste from node bootstrap logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:02Z bootstrap: kms.DecryptDenied: AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789:key/abcd-ef01
    while calling keystore.Decrypt
    fallback = NAT egress to kms.amazonaws.com:443 -> 10.0.3.14:32543
```
mira: the weird thing is the role ARN looks correct for the pool, but the new IAM boundary policy is more restrictive. some nodes fall back to privatelink, others to NAT -> large egress and cost blip.
jon: so two problems: 1) decrypt denies due to boundary, 2) fallback causing NAT traffic and cost. are VPC endpoints failing?
mira: yes, we saw 503s on privatelink endpoint in 1a and 1b around same time. endpoint health shows transient thundering-herd from 30 nodes.
adele: Punting to rollback IAM boundary ASAP? compliance asked to keep boundary tight though. can we patch a temporary allow for the keystore role only in apac?
oliver: we could add a scoped exception for kms:Decrypt for the keystore key's resource, or attach an inline policy to the node bootstrap role. quick rollback is safest for availability.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-APAC-KMS-ROLLFAIL. Paging oncall infra and infra-platform.
jon: if we rollback, we still need to address privatelink capacity. the endpoint quota might need an increase or we need regional LB throttles. also audit logs are missing for a subset of requests — CloudTrail gaps?
mira: confirmed: CloudTrail shows sampling for kms:Decrypt from the endpoint IPs between 03:10-03:20. compliance flagged a 7m gap where eventIds are missing for some decrypt calls.
adele: ugh. compliance needs a root cause note. action items: rollback IAM boundary in apac, open privatelink support ticket + increase ENI quota if needed, add temporary keystore allow, and run a sampling of node bootstraps to validate.
oliver: for rollback: I'm drafting a minimal patch that re-adds kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789:key/abcd-ef01 for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/keystore-bootstrap-apac. ready to apply on your +1.
jon: +1 from me. but can we gate it with a canary set to 3 nodes only, verify logs, then expand?
mira: yes, canary then expand. steps I will do after rollback:
- verify node Decrypt success and bootstrap progress
- monitor natgw egress metric and cost alarms
- check privatelink endpoint error rate
- run CloudTrail verify script (quick grep for RequestParameters.KeyId)

jon: quick helper command to check decrypt errors in logs:
```
grep -E "kms.Decrypt|DecryptDenied" /var/log/bootstrap.log | tail -n 200
```
adele: I'll draft the compliance postmortem note template. include timestamps, affected node IDs, and the IAM diff.
sre-bot: Postmortem checklist added to INC-2026-0319-APAC-KMS-ROLLFAIL: add timeline, rollback diff, mitigations, and cost impact estimate.
mira: after rollback and canary passed, we should do a follow-up to harden privatelink: 1) add connection draining on our side 2) autoscale endpoint ENIs by warm-pool size 3) avoid NAT fallback by failing fast at bootstrap if privatelink unreachable (so we don't incur egress cost).
oliver: agree. also suggest adding a simulated keystore test to our rollout CI so boundary policy changes run against a mock decrypt before merge.
jon: timeline? when can we roll back?
mira: rolling back now. will update in ~10 min with canary results.

[some time later]
mira: rollback applied, canary (3 nodes) bootstrapped successfully, kms.Decrypt OK, privatelink errors dropped to baseline. expanding to remaining nodes now.
jon: monitoring NATGW cost, dropped 92% since rollback. nice.
adele: compliance note drafted, will attach IAM diff and CloudTrail output.
sre-bot: Incident resolved: INC-2026-0319-APAC-KMS-ROLLFAIL -> status: mitigated. Postmortem owner: adele.
mira: follow-ups filed: TICKET-3271 (privatelink capacity), TICKET-3272 (role-boundary CI test), TICKET-3273 (fail-fast bootstrap). leaving this thread for handoff to oncall docs. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
